gaps.explanation: No business-type schedule; the Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Net Position - Modified Cash Basis - Proprietary Funds (p7) prints Electric, Sewer and Water Fund columns. Added: Electric 549,833 + 5,367 + 4,100 = 559,300; Sewer 102,111 + 25,788 + 1,947 = 129,846; Water 139,809 + 54,800 + 954 + 2,542 = 198,105. Total 887,251 (gap 0).
